ESV.1: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
ESV.2: “The people of Israel shall camp each by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers' houses. They shall camp facing the tent of meeting on every side.
ESV.3: Those to camp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah by their companies, the chief of the people of Judah being Nahshon the son of Amminadab,
ESV.5: Those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar, the chief of the people of Issachar being Nethanel the son of Zuar,
ESV.7: Then the tribe of Zebulun, the chief of the people of Zebulun being Eliab the son of Helon,
ESV.9: All those listed of the camp of Judah, by their companies, were 186,400. They shall set out first on the march.
ESV.10: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben by their companies, the chief of the people of Reuben being Elizur the son of Shedeur,
ESV.12: And those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon, the chief of the people of Simeon being Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai,
ESV.14: Then the tribe of Gad, the chief of the people of Gad being Eliasaph the son of Reuel,
ESV.16: All those listed of the camp of Reuben, by their companies, were 151,450. They shall set out second.
ESV.17: “Then the tent of meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps; as they camp, so shall they set out, each in position, standard by standard.
ESV.18: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim by their companies, the chief of the people of Ephraim being Elishama the son of Ammihud,
ESV.20: And next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh, the chief of the people of Manasseh being Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur,
ESV.22: Then the tribe of Benjamin, the chief of the people of Benjamin being Abidan the son of Gideoni,
ESV.24: All those listed of the camp of Ephraim, by their companies, were 108,100. They shall set out third on the march.
ESV.25: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan by their companies, the chief of the people of Dan being Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai,
ESV.27: And those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher, the chief of the people of Asher being Pagiel the son of Ochran,
ESV.29: Then the tribe of Naphtali, the chief of the people of Naphtali being Ahira the son of Enan,
ESV.31: All those listed of the camp of Dan were 157,600. They shall set out last, standard by standard.”
ESV.32: These are the people of Israel as listed by their fathers' houses. All those listed in the camps by their companies were 603,550.
ESV.33: But the Levites were not listed among the people of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.
ESV.34: Thus did the people of Israel. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they camped by their standards, and so they set out, each one in his clan, according to his fathers' house.

NASB.1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
NASB.2: 'The sons of Israel shall camp, each by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers' households; they shall camp around the tent of meeting at a distance.
NASB.3: 'Now those who camp on the east side toward the sunrise [shall be] of the standard of the camp of Judah, by their armies, and the leader of the sons of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab,
NASB.4: and his army, even their numbered men, 74,600.
NASB.5: 'Those who camp next to him [shall be] the tribe of Issachar, and the leader of the sons of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar,
NASB.6: and his army, even their numbered men, 54,400.
NASB.7: '[Then] [comes] the tribe of Zebulun, and the leader of the sons of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon,
NASB.8: and his army, even his numbered men, 57,400.
NASB.9: 'The total of the numbered men of the camp of Judah: 186,400, by their armies. They shall set out first.
NASB.10: 'On the south side [shall be] the standard of the camp of Reuben by their armies, and the leader of the sons of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur,
NASB.11: and his army, even their numbered men, 46,500.
NASB.12: 'Those who camp next to him [shall be] the tribe of Simeon, and the leader of the sons of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai,
NASB.13: and his army, even their numbered men, 59,300.
NASB.14: 'Then [comes] the tribe of Gad, and the leader of the sons of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel,
NASB.15: and his army, even their numbered men, 45,650.
NASB.16: 'The total of the numbered men of the camp of Reuben: 151,450 by their armies. And they shall set out second.
NASB.17: 'Then the tent of meeting shall set out [with] the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps; just as they camp, so they shall set out, every man in his place by their standards.
NASB.18: 'On the west side [shall be] the standard of the camp of Ephraim by their armies, and the leader of the sons of Ephraim [shall be] Elishama the son of Ammihud,
NASB.19: and his army, even their numbered men, 40,500.
NASB.20: 'Next to him [shall be] the tribe of Manasseh, and the leader of the sons of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur,
NASB.21: and his army, even their numbered men, 32,200.
NASB.22: 'Then [comes] the tribe of Benjamin, and the leader of the sons of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni,
NASB.23: and his army, even their numbered men, 35,400.
NASB.24: 'The total of the numbered men of the camp of Ephraim: 108,100, by their armies. And they shall set out third.
NASB.25: 'On the north side [shall be] the standard of the camp of Dan by their armies, and the leader of the sons of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai,
NASB.26: and his army, even their numbered men, 62,700.
NASB.27: 'Those who camp next to him [shall be] the tribe of Asher, and the leader of the sons of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran,
NASB.28: and his army, even their numbered men, 41,500.
NASB.29: 'Then [comes] the tribe of Naphtali, and the leader of the sons of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan,
NASB.30: and his army, even their numbered men, 53,400.
NASB.31: 'The total of the numbered men of the camp of Dan [was] 157,600. They shall set out last by their standards.'
NASB.32: These are the numbered men of the sons of Israel by their fathers' households; the total of the numbered men of the camps by their armies, 603,550.
NASB.33: The Levites, however, were not numbered among the sons of Israel, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.34: Thus the sons of Israel did; according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they camped by their standards, and so they set out, every one by his family according to his father's household.

NKJV.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
NKJV.2: “Everyone of the children of Israel shall camp by his own standard, beside the emblems of his father’s house; they shall camp some distance from the tabernacle of meeting.
NKJV.3: On the east side, toward the rising of the sun, those of the standard of the forces with Judah shall camp according to their armies; and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be the leader of the children of Judah.”
NKJV.4: And his army was numbered at seventy-four thousand six hundred.
NKJV.5: “Those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar, and Nethanel the son of Zuar shall be the leader of the children of Issachar.”
NKJV.6: And his army was numbered at fifty-four thousand four hundred.
NKJV.7: “Then comes the tribe of Zebulun, and Eliab the son of Helon shall be the leader of the children of Zebulun.”
NKJV.8: And his army was numbered at fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
NKJV.9: “All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Judah, one hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred— these shall break camp first.
NKJV.10: “On the south side shall be the standard of the forces with Reuben according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.”
NKJV.11: And his army was numbered at forty-six thousand five hundred.
NKJV.12: “Those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon, and the leader of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.”
NKJV.13: And his army was numbered at fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
NKJV.14: “Then comes the tribe of Gad, and the leader of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.”
NKJV.15: And his army was numbered at forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
NKJV.16: “All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Reuben, one hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty— they shall be the second to break camp.
NKJV.17: “And the tabernacle of meeting shall move out with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps; as they camp, so they shall move out, everyone in his place, by their standards.
NKJV.18: “On the west side shall be the standard of the forces with Ephraim according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.”
NKJV.19: And his army was numbered at forty thousand five hundred.
NKJV.20: “Next to him comes the tribe of Manasseh, and the leader of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.”
NKJV.21: And his army was numbered at thirty-two thousand two hundred.
NKJV.22: “Then comes the tribe of Benjamin, and the leader of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.”
NKJV.23: And his army was numbered at thirty-five thousand four hundred.
NKJV.24: “All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Ephraim, one hundred and eight thousand one hundred— they shall be the third to break camp.
NKJV.25: “The standard of the forces with Dan shall be on the north side according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.”
NKJV.26: And his army was numbered at sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
NKJV.27: “Those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher, and the leader of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.”
NKJV.28: And his army was numbered at forty-one thousand five hundred.
NKJV.29: “Then comes the tribe of Naphtali, and the leader of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.”
NKJV.30: And his army was numbered at fifty-three thousand four hundred.
NKJV.31: “All who were numbered of the forces with Dan, one hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred— they shall break camp last, with their standards.”
NKJV.32: These are the ones who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
NKJV.33: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel, just as the LORD commanded Moses.
NKJV.34: Thus the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they camped by their standards and so they broke camp, each one by his family, according to their fathers’ houses.

WEB.1: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
WEB.2: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses: at a distance from the Tent of Meeting shall they encamp around it.”
WEB.3: Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
WEB.4: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
WEB.5: Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and the prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.
WEB.6: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
WEB.7: The tribe of Zebulun: and the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.
WEB.8: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
WEB.9: All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.
WEB.10: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
WEB.11: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
WEB.12: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
WEB.13: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
WEB.14: “The tribe of Gad: and the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
WEB.15: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
WEB.16: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.
WEB.17: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.
WEB.18: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
WEB.19: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.
WEB.20: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
WEB.21: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
WEB.22: “The tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
WEB.23: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
WEB.24: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.
WEB.25: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
WEB.26: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
WEB.27: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.
WEB.28: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.
WEB.29: “The tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
WEB.30: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
WEB.31: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”
WEB.32: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
WEB.33: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
WEB.34: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

NLT.2: “When the Israelites set up camp, each tribe will be assigned its own area. The tribal divisions will camp beneath their family banners on all four sides of the Tabernacle, but at some distance from it.
NLT.3:
[3-4] “The divisions of Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun are to camp toward the sunrise on the east side of the Tabernacle, beneath their family banners. These are the names of the tribes, their leaders, and the numbers of their registered troops: Tribe — Leader — Number
Judah — Nahshon son of Amminadab — 74,600
NLT.9: So the total of all the troops on Judah’s side of the camp is 186,400. These three tribes are to lead the way whenever the Israelites travel to a new campsite.
NLT.10:
[10-11] “The divisions of Reuben, Simeon, and Gad are to camp on the south side of the Tabernacle, beneath their family banners. These are the names of the tribes, their leaders, and the numbers of their registered troops: Tribe — Leader — Number
Reuben — Elizur son of Shedeur — 46,500
NLT.16: So the total of all the troops on Reuben’s side of the camp is 151,450. These three tribes will be second in line whenever the Israelites travel.
NLT.17: “Then the Tabernacle, carried by the Levites, will set out from the middle of the camp. All the tribes are to travel in the same order that they camp, each in position under the appropriate family banner.
NLT.18:
[18-19] “The divisions of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Benjamin are to camp on the west side of the Tabernacle, beneath their family banners. These are the names of the tribes, their leaders, and the numbers of their registered troops: Tribe — Leader — Number
Ephraim — Elishama son of Ammihud — 40,500
NLT.24: So the total of all the troops on Ephraim’s side of the camp is 108,100. These three tribes will be third in line whenever the Israelites travel.
NLT.25:
[25-26] “The divisions of Dan, Asher, and Naphtali are to camp on the north side of the Tabernacle, beneath their family banners. These are the names of the tribes, their leaders, and the numbers of their registered troops: Tribe — Leader — Number
Dan — Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai — 62,700
NLT.31: So the total of all the troops on Dan’s side of the camp is 157,600. These three tribes will be last, marching under their banners whenever the Israelites travel.”
NLT.32: In summary, the troops of Israel listed by their families totaled 603,550.
NLT.33: But as the LORD had commanded, the Levites were not included in this registration.
NLT.34: So the people of Israel did everything as the LORD had commanded Moses. Each clan and family set up camp and marched under their banners exactly as the LORD had instructed them.

AMP.1: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
AMP.2: "The sons of Israel shall camp, each by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers' households; they shall camp around the Tent of Meeting (tabernacle), but at a distance.
AMP.3: Those who camp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, by their armies; and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall lead the sons of Judah,
AMP.4: and his army as numbered totaled 74,600.
AMP.5: Next to Judah [on the east side] the tribe of Issachar shall encamp; and Nethanel the son of Zuar shall lead the sons of Issachar,
AMP.6: and his army as numbered totaled 54,400.
AMP.7: Then [also on the east side] the tribe of Zebulun; and Eliab the son of Helon shall lead the sons of Zebulun,
AMP.8: and his army as numbered totaled 57,400.
AMP.9: The total of the numbered men [in the three tribes on the east side] in the camp of Judah was 186,400, by their armies. They shall move out first [on the march].
AMP.10: "On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben, by their armies; and Elizur the son of Shedeur shall lead the sons of Reuben,
AMP.11: and his army as numbered totaled 46,500.
AMP.12: Those who camp next to Reuben [on the south side] shall be the tribe of Simeon; and Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai shall lead the sons of Simeon,
AMP.13: and his army as numbered totaled 59,300.
AMP.14: Then [completing the south side] the tribe of Gad; and Eliasaph the son of Reuel (Deuel) shall lead the sons of Gad,
AMP.15: and his army as numbered totaled 45,650.
AMP.16: The total of the numbered men [in the three tribes on the south side] in the camp of Reuben was 151,450, by their armies. They shall move out second [on the march].
AMP.17: "Then the Tent of Meeting (tabernacle) shall move out with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the [other] camps; just as they camp so shall they move out, every man in his place by their standards.
AMP.18: "On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim, by their armies; and Elishama the son of Ammihud shall lead the sons of Ephraim,
AMP.19: and his army as numbered totaled 40,500.
AMP.20: Beside Ephraim [on the west side] shall be the tribe of Manasseh; and Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur shall lead the sons of Manasseh,
AMP.21: and his army as numbered totaled 32,200.
AMP.22: Then [completing the west side shall be] the tribe of Benjamin; and Abidan the son of Gideoni shall lead the sons of Benjamin,
AMP.23: and his army as numbered totaled 35,400.
AMP.24: The total of the numbered men [of the three tribes on the west side] in the camp of Ephraim was 108,100, by their armies. They shall move out in third place.
AMP.25: "On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan, by their armies; and Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai shall lead the sons of Dan,
AMP.26: and his army as numbered totaled 62,700.
AMP.27: Encamped next to Dan [on the north side] shall be the tribe of Asher; and Pagiel the son of Ochran shall lead the sons of Asher,
AMP.28: and his army as numbered totaled 41,500.
AMP.29: Then [completing the north side] comes the tribe of Naphtali; and Ahira the son of Enan shall lead the sons of Naphtali,
AMP.30: and his army as numbered totaled 53,400.
AMP.31: The total of the numbered men [of the three tribes on the north side] in the camp of Dan was 157,600. They shall move out last, standard after standard."
AMP.32: These are the men of the Israelites [twenty years old and upward] as numbered by their fathers' households. The total of the numbered men of the camps by their armies, 603,550.
AMP.33: But the Levites were not numbered with the [other] Israelites, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
AMP.34: Thus the Israelites did [as ordered]; according to everything the LORD had commanded Moses, so they camped by their standards, and so they moved out, everyone with his family (clan), according to his fathers' household.

MSG.1: God spoke to Moses and Aaron. He said,

MSG.7: And the tribe of Zebulun is next to them, led by Eliab son of Helon.

MSG.10: To the south are the companies of the camp of Reuben under its flag, led by Elizur son of Shedeur.
MSG.12: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to them, led by Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.

NIV.1:
The Arrangement of the Tribal Camps
The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:
NIV.2: “The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting some distance from it, each man under his standard with the banners of his family.”
NIV.3: On the east, toward the sunrise, the divisions of the camp of Judah are to encamp under their standard. The leader of the people of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.
NIV.5: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.
NIV.7: The tribe of Zebulun will be next. The leader of the people of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.
NIV.9: All the men assigned to the camp of Judah, according to their divisions, number 186,400. They will set out first.
NIV.10: On the south will be the divisions of the camp of Reuben under their standard. The leader of the people of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.
NIV.12: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
NIV.14: The tribe of Gad will be next. The leader of the people of Gad is Eliasaph son of Deuel.
NIV.16: All the men assigned to the camp of Reuben, according to their divisions, number 151,450. They will set out second.

NIV.20: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to them. The leader of the people of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
NIV.22: The tribe of Benjamin will be next. The leader of the people of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni.
NIV.24: All the men assigned to the camp of Ephraim, according to their divisions, number 108,100. They will set out third.
NIV.25: On the north will be the divisions of the camp of Dan, under their standard. The leader of the people of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
NIV.27: The tribe of Asher will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Asher is Pagiel son of Ocran.
NIV.29: The tribe of Naphtali will be next. The leader of the people of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.

NRSVCE.1: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
NRSVCE.2: The Israelites shall camp each in their respective regiments, under ensigns by their ancestral houses; they shall camp facing the tent of meeting on every side.
NRSVCE.3: Those to camp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the regimental encampment of Judah by companies. The leader of the people of Judah shall be Nahshon son of Amminadab,
NRSVCE.4: with a company as enrolled of seventy-four thousand six hundred.
NRSVCE.5: Those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The leader of the Issacharites shall be Nethanel son of Zuar,
NRSVCE.6: with a company as enrolled of fifty-four thousand four hundred.
NRSVCE.7: Then the tribe of Zebulun: The leader of the Zebulunites shall be Eliab son of Helon,
NRSVCE.8: with a company as enrolled of fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
NRSVCE.9: The total enrollment of the camp of Judah, by companies, is one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred. They shall set out first on the march.
NRSVCE.10: On the south side shall be the regimental encampment of Reuben by companies. The leader of the Reubenites shall be Elizur son of Shedeur,
NRSVCE.11: with a company as enrolled of forty-six thousand five hundred.
NRSVCE.12: And those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The leader of the Simeonites shall be Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
NRSVCE.13: with a company as enrolled of fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
NRSVCE.14: Then the tribe of Gad: The leader of the Gadites shall be Eliasaph son of Reuel,
NRSVCE.15: with a company as enrolled of forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
NRSVCE.16: The total enrollment of the camp of Reuben, by companies, is one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty. They shall set out second.
NRSVCE.17: The tent of meeting, with the camp of the Levites, shall set out in the center of the camps; they shall set out just as they camp, each in position, by their regiments.
NRSVCE.18: On the west side shall be the regimental encampment of Ephraim by companies. The leader of the people of Ephraim shall be Elishama son of Ammihud,
NRSVCE.19: with a company as enrolled of forty thousand five hundred.
NRSVCE.20: Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The leader of the people of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
NRSVCE.21: with a company as enrolled of thirty-two thousand two hundred.
NRSVCE.22: Then the tribe of Benjamin: The leader of the Benjaminites shall be Abidan son of Gideoni,
NRSVCE.23: with a company as enrolled of thirty-five thousand four hundred.
NRSVCE.24: The total enrollment of the camp of Ephraim, by companies, is one hundred eight thousand one hundred. They shall set out third on the march.
NRSVCE.25: On the north side shall be the regimental encampment of Dan by companies. The leader of the Danites shall be Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai,
NRSVCE.26: with a company as enrolled of sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
NRSVCE.27: Those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The leader of the Asherites shall be Pagiel son of Ochran,
NRSVCE.28: with a company as enrolled of forty-one thousand five hundred.
NRSVCE.29: Then the tribe of Naphtali: The leader of the Naphtalites shall be Ahira son of Enan,
NRSVCE.30: with a company as enrolled of fifty-three thousand four hundred.
NRSVCE.31: The total enrollment of the camp of Dan is one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last, by companies.
NRSVCE.32: This was the enrollment of the Israelites by their ancestral houses; the total enrollment in the camps by their companies was six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
NRSVCE.33: Just as the LORD had commanded Moses, the Levites were not enrolled among the other Israelites.
NRSVCE.34: The Israelites did just as the LORD had commanded Moses: They camped by regiments, and they set out the same way, everyone by clans, according to ancestral houses.
